description: Header file defining the MultiLogCTVerifier class for verifying Signed Certificate Timestamps from multiple logs in Certificate Transparency. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal data structures.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier
classes.description: A verifier for Signed Certificate Timestamps from multiple logs, implementing the CTVerifier interface.

classes.name: MultiLogCTVerifier::CTLogProvider
classes.description: Provides a list of CTLogVerifier instances and manages callbacks for log list updates.

methods.name: SetLogs
methods.description: Sets the list of log verifiers to be used for verification.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies SCTs against a certificate and hostname, producing a list of verified SCTs.

methods.name: VerifySCTs
methods.description: Verifies a list of SCTs from an encoded list against an expected entry.

methods.name: VerifySingleSCT
methods.description: Verifies a single SCT against all logs.
